subject: Latest update can be downloaded for free
author: Xandu
body:
You should be able to download the latest update of Burnout Paradise for free even if you are not a XBox Live gold member. As a free silver member all you need to do is to connect to xbox live then you find the update under the Burnout Paradise category in game marketplace.
